actions.name: Exploit CVE-2021-44077 in Zoho ManageEngine ServiceDesk Plus
actions.description: Exploitation of CVE-2021-44077, an unauthenticated remote code execution vulnerability in ServiceDesk Plus versions up to 11305, allowing unrestricted file upload and execution.

actions.name: Upload executable file msiexec.exe as dropper
actions.description: Upload of executable file msiexec.exe to C:\ManageEngine\Servicedesk\bin\ as a dropper containing an embedded encoded Godzilla JAR file.

actions.name: Execute dropper to decode and drop Godzilla JAR file
actions.description: Execution of the uploaded dropper via a second POST request to decode the embedded Godzilla JAR file and drop it to C:\ManageEngine\ServiceDesk\lib\tomcat\tomcat-postgres.jar.

actions.name: Write webshells to disk for initial persistence
actions.description: Writing webshells to disk to maintain initial persistence on compromised systems.

actions.description: Obfuscation and deobfuscation/decoding of files or information to evade detection.

actions.name: Dump user credentials
actions.description: Dumping user credentials from compromised systems.

actions.name: Use signed Windows binaries for follow-on actions
actions.description: Living off the land by using only signed Windows binaries for subsequent actions.

actions.name: Add or delete user accounts as needed
actions.description: Adding or deleting user accounts on compromised systems as needed.

actions.name: Steal copies of Active Directory database or registry hives
actions.description: Stealing copies of the Active Directory database (NTDS.dit) or registry hives from compromised systems.

actions.name: Use Windows Management Instrumentation (WMI) for remote execution
actions.description: Using WMI for remote execution and lateral movement.

actions.description: Deleting files to remove indicators of compromise from the host.
